entities.name: Konrad VIII the Younger
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Konrad VIII the Younger, was a Duke of Oleśnica, Koźle, half of Bytom and half of Ścinawa during 1416–1427 and sole Duke of half of Ścinawa since 1427 until his death.
